verdict.rationale: Appwrite has a public GitHub repository (github.com/appwrite/appwrite), and a community member calls it 'an open-source alternative to Vercel', which points to readable source. The pack, however, never names the license, and no first-party doc states the source is openly licensed. The open-source Skills files and the API specs repo are separate artifacts, not the product's own source, so they do not count here. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement of an open license (e.g. the license name or file), and documentation that the full product source is available to read.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Integrated hosting platform to deploy and scale web applications with support for custom domains, SSR, and seamless backend integration.
the product itself looks worthwhile as an open-source alternative to Vercel
